==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am at a large mansion. There seem to be children running around everywhere with no supervision. I am fairly calm despite the chaos.

I recruit a few of the random children to join my monster hunting guild. Equipped with wooden stakes, we all decide to go patrolling in search of monsters. Our patrol leads us to the mall.

Inside the mall we hear people screaming. There is a pile of debris blocking our view of something down a corridor. I wake up before we can figure out what's on the other side of the debris.
